landing.title: Pay all your vendors in one go.
landing.subtitle: Keep vendor bank details in one trusted place, bring in due bills, approve once and pay through your own bank.
landing.trust: TArrow never holds your money and never asks for your bank login or OTP.

auth.signInHelp: We'll email you a sign-in link. No password needed.
auth.checkEmailBody: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. Open it on this device.
auth.linkError: That sign-in link didn't work. It may have expired — request a new one.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
auth.upgradeDemo: Save this demo? Sign in with email to keep a real workspace.

onboarding.title: Set up your business
onboarding.body: One business is one workspace. You can add more later.

demo.banner: Demo workspace — fictional data, test money only.
demo.resetBody: This restores all demo vendors, bills and runs to the starting point.
demo.expires: Demo workspaces are deleted after 24 hours.

validation.accountMismatch: The two account numbers don't match.

validation.holderRequired: Add the account holder's name as printed by the bank.
validation.upi: UPI ID should look like name@bank.
validation.gstin: This GSTIN isn't valid. Check the 15 characters.
validation.creditDays: Credit days should be between 0 and 365.
validation.nameMismatch: Account holder name doesn't look like the vendor name. Double-check before approving.

validation.ifscNotFound: We couldn't find this IFSC. Check it with the vendor.
validation.ifscLookupFailed: Couldn't look up the bank right now.

vendors.title: Vendors
vendors.emptyBody: Add the people and businesses you pay.
vendors.addHow: How do you have their details?
vendors.methodRequestHint: Send a secure link to fill
vendors.pastePlaceholder: e.g. A/c name: Sunrise Pharma, A/c no: 50100123456789, IFSC: HDFC0001234
vendors.onDevice: Read on your phone. Nothing is uploaded.
vendors.photoTip: Tip: you can also copy text from the photo using your phone (iPhone Live Text or Google Lens) and paste it here.
vendors.cropHint: Drag to select the part with bank details (optional).
vendors.ocrFailed: Couldn't read this photo. Try a clearer photo, or paste the text.
vendors.checkFields: Check the details below. Highlighted fields need a look.
vendors.chooseOne: Found more than one — tap the right one:
vendors.nothingFound: We couldn't find bank details in this. Fill them in below.

form.displayNameHint: The name you use for them
form.creditDaysHint: Used to work out due dates when a bill has none

vendors.savedNeedsReview: Vendor saved. Review the bank details to verify them.

detail.pendingReview: New bank details are waiting for your review.
detail.blocked: Blocked from payment runs until you review the change.
detail.deleteBody: Their bills stay in your records. You can't undo this.

review.title: Review bank details
review.intro: Changed bank details are the most common way payment fraud happens. Confirm the new details with the vendor on a phone call you start.
review.holdNote: Payments to this vendor are held for 24 hours after approval (Settings).
review.confirmBody: Future payments to {name} will go to account {account}.
review.nothingPending: There are no bank-detail changes waiting for review.

request.title: Ask the vendor for details
request.body: We'll make a secure link that works once and expires in 7 days. The vendor fills in their details; you review before anything is used.
request.message: Hello, please share your bank details for payments from {business} using this secure link: {url}

home.title: Home
home.dueSummary: {amount} across {count, plural, one {# vendor} other {# vendors}}
home.nothingDue: Nothing due in the next 7 days
home.nothingDueBody: Add bills to plan your next payment run.
home.allGood: All clear. Nothing needs your attention.

attention.changed: {count, plural, one {# vendor changed bank details} other {# vendors changed bank details}}
attention.missing: {count, plural, one {# vendor is missing bank details} other {# vendors are missing bank details}}

tour.step1Body: See what's due and anything that needs a look — most important first.
tour.step2Body: Pick the bills, review one payment per vendor, then pay them all in one go.
tour.step3Body: You confirm every money step. Pay by bank file, UPI or Direct pay (test mode).

bills.title: Bills
bills.emptyBody: Add bills from your accounting export, a photo, or by hand.

invoice.title: Bill from invoice
invoice.body: Take a photo of the invoice or choose a PDF. It's read on your phone and not uploaded.
invoice.noText: We couldn't read text from this. Try a clearer photo or enter the bill by hand.
invoice.keepCopy: A copy of the image will be kept (Settings → Keep invoice images).

bills.overdueBy: {days, plural, one {# day overdue} other {# days overdue}}
bills.dueIn: {days, plural, =0 {Due today} one {Due tomorrow} other {Due in # days}}
bills.methodImportHint: Export from Tally, Marg or Busy
bills.methodInvoiceHint: Read on your phone — nothing is uploaded

form.dueDateHint: Leave empty to use invoice date + {days} credit days ({date}).
form.dueDateHintNoInvoice: Leave empty to use the invoice date + the vendor's credit days.
form.needDueOrInvoiceDate: Add an invoice date or a due date.

actions.referenceRequired: A UTR or reference is required.

actions.inRun: This bill is part of run #{number}.

import.title: Import bills
import.uploadBody: Excel (.xlsx, .xls) or CSV. The file is read on your device; only the bills you import are saved.
import.readError: Couldn't read this file. Is it an Excel or CSV export?
import.noRows: No rows found in this file.
import.mapBody: Tell us which column holds each detail. We've guessed where we could.
import.missingRequired: Map vendor, invoice number and amount to continue.
import.importN: Import {count, plural, one {# bill} other {# bills}}
import.imported: {count, plural, one {# bill imported} other {# bills imported}}

vendorRequest.title: Share your bank details
vendorRequest.intro: {business} uses TArrow to pay vendors. Enter the account where you want to receive payments.
vendorRequest.consent: I confirm these are my bank details and I agree to share them with {business} for receiving payments.
vendorRequest.consentRequired: Please tick the box to continue.

vendorRequest.invalidBody: It may have expired or already been used. Ask the business to send a new link.
vendorRequest.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again in a few minutes.
vendorRequest.secure: Your details go only to this business. TArrow never asks for your bank password or OTP.
